SEQ.Settings.Mode.Name: Sequential Attacks
SEQ.Settings.Mode.Hint: Roll attacks one at a time. Ask: the attack dialog offers it, unticked. Always: on for full attacks, quick rolls included.
SEQ.Settings.LegacyTheme.Name: Use Legacy Theme
SEQ.Settings.LegacyTheme.Hint: Restores the tracker window's original colour scheme (blue current attack, green resolved, gold skipped). Off by default, which uses the amber-on-dark theme shared with this author's other PF1 modules. Appearance only — nothing about how attacks resolve changes.

SEQ.Button.RollAllMulti: Roll All Remaining ({count}), one card per action
